description: This file implements the core functions for a TLS Crypto Provider Object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization of the provider, which includes setting up cryptographic algorithms, key generation, and handling cryptographic primitives. It defines functions to instantiate and manage the lifecycle of the crypto provider within a TLS context.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE TlsCpoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new TLS Crypto Provider Object, setting up its function pointers and internal handles.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCpoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the TLS Crypto Provider Object, releasing its associated cryptographic resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCpoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls required cryptographic objects such as the crypto interface and public key crypto interface.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCpoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the TLS Crypto Provider Object, setting up function pointers and member variables specific to this object.
